title: Reward Hacking Onset: Finding the Optimization Pressure Threshold

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Empirically locating the Goodhart threshold in a simple environment helps practitioners but the toy RL setting limits direct applicability to LLM alignment. The connection to real-world safety is more indirect than LLM-based experiments.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple RL environment (CartPole/gridworld) with PPO. Well-documented in standard RL tutorials. Defining proxy vs. true reward is the creative step. Low compute requirements. Accessible for CS students with basic RL knowledge.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single environment, single misspecified reward, varying gradient steps. Clear deliverable: divergence curve with threshold. Very focused experiment. Well within 30 hours.
